sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "signals"."telescref" AS e, "telescopes"."calibrstatus" AS g, AVG("signals"."polarangledeg") AS m1 FROM "signals" JOIN "telescopes" ON "telescopes"."telescregistry" = "signals"."telescref"  GROUP BY "signals"."telescref", "telescopes"."calibrstatus"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: average of polarization angle per telescopes within telescopes.calibrstatus
gap to the all average of average of polarization angle (all level)
rank within the group by average of polarization angle, keep the top 3

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "telescopes"."observstation" AS e, "observatories"."weathprofile" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "telescopes" JOIN "observatories" ON "observatories"."observstation" = "telescopes"."observstation"  GROUP BY "telescopes"."observstation", "observatories"."weathprofile"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m2" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: index against the g average of number of telescopes records (g level)
rank within the group by number of telescopes records: index against the g average, keep the top 3
